Sucks he went to dook bc there’s no ceiling on this dude. Also I have stopped feeling bad for Mavs fans. You’ve had three guys who could end up top 25 all time in a row.


Fullcourtpass (@Fullcourtpass)

Cooper Flagg passed the game winning shot to Naji Marshall and was confident he would hit the shot

“TAKE ME HOME”

(h/t @MavsMuse)

Video
  





— https://nitter.net/Fullcourtpass/status/2036398866329714952#m
Draft over. Claude drafted me three shortstops (although at good value for a 17 team auction draft) and only one pitcher who is out for the year with Tommy John
I'm having claude run my fantasy baseball draft right now in real time and its mostly drafted players with a Z in their name.

Been around just long enough for ALL CAPS to turn into an AI ad


Kurrco (@Kurrco)

22 years ago today, MF DOOM & Madlib released ‘Madvillainy’ 💿







— https://nitter.net/Kurrco/status/2035929542771020252#m
He didn’t actually throw a punch here. He wound up and then just grabbed back at the ball. The actual act of wild aggression was the Florida dude trying to rip the dudes arm out after the whistle
Sacramento Kings do not draft Peterson
KANSAS YOU DESERVED THAT FOR THE DISGUSTING UNETHICAL FOUL TO GIVE SHENNANIGANS
I can’t tell you how much I hate Peterson’s effort and intensity in this game. This is the first pick in the draft and a franchise cornerstone?
I feel like everyone with a brain could sniff out Chappell Roan being awful from the second she arrived but we were all silenced

Top 5 community note of all time.


Pete Hegseth (@PeteHegseth)

💯

Video
  


Community note: This is a video from 2021. Sgt Maj Bull who’s in the video is no longer in. He was actually relieved of duty when he was caught breaking into one of his own Marine’s home. He has since been retired and no longer is on Active Duty.

taskandpurpose.com/news/marine-co…

tiktok.com/@bull52772/vid…





— https://nitter.net/PeteHegseth/status/2035186372219224567#m
99 on high point you are my hero please don’t clue me in on your political beliefs

Great effort from Siena in the first half but the pace and rhythm of the game is all tilting towards Duke. Second half will be a bloodbath but respect for all the Long Island dudes on Siena we see you
Woke 2.0 starts with dook and Wisconsin losing
We as a press corps need to come clean and admit we did not properly cover the Afroman trial.
I’m sorry but Reed Shepard looks like he’s in a movie about a kid who got three wishes and now can play in the NBA
